tasks.behavior: Go packages share one definition for each repeated money concept instead of copying its fields
acceptance: The token identity fields repeated across balance.Token, balance.TokenHistory, activity.Item, activity.Transfer, invoice.Invoice and the httpapi response structs come from one type in the owning package (embedded or reused) where the meaning matches; invoice.Issuer reuses profile.BillingDetails' fields if the meaning matches (a frozen copy stays a copy in the database); invoice.Deposit reuses finality.Progress for blocks and time left; no global types/models/common package; JSON field names, API responses (openapi.yaml) and money representation unchanged; Go tests stay beside their package; go test -list before and after shows every test
notes: 2026-10-11 review pass by reviewer: Pass. chain.Asset (internal/chain/asset.go:4) is now the one token identity, embedded in balance.Token, balance.TokenHistory, activity.Item, activity.Transfer, invoice.Invoice; httpapi money.go response structs share tokenJSON via toTokenJSON. invoice.Invoice.Issuer is *profile.Issuer, embedded in profile.BillingDetails; invoices still copy billing details in SQL (create.go:56), scanInvoice unchanged except type. invoice.Deposit embeds finality.Progress (get.go:87 assigns it whole). invoiceJSON keeps its own chainId/token, correct since it has no symbol/decimals. No types/common package; chain and finality import no domain package; new invoice->profile edge is acyclic; no domain imports httpapi/cmd. JSON keys and order unchanged (encoding/json flattens the untagged embedded tokenJSON at its field position; checked with a scratch program for activityItemJSON and tokenBalanceJSON). openapi.yaml and packages/contracts unchanged; money stays *big.Int / decimal strings; no test files touched. go1.27.1, go build ./..., go vet -tags e2e,privylive,loadtest ./..., gofmt clean, pnpm --filter @forwend/backend test all ok. Non-blocking: balance/history.go:96 could be TokenHistory{Asset: t.Asset}; httpapi/money.go:16 comment only restates the type.

proof.1: backend: chain.Asset is embedded in balance.Token, balance.TokenHistory, activity.Item, activity.Transfer and invoice.Invoice, httpapi tokenJSON in the four money responses at the same key position, profile.Issuer is embedded in BillingDetails and used for invoice.Issuer, finality.Progress embedded in invoice.Deposit; httpapi, invoice, balance, activity and profile tests pass unchanged against real Postgres; openapi.yaml and migrations untouched; go test -list with e2e,privylive,loadtest tags shows the same 179 tests before and after

tasks.behavior: The app shows short toasts in the corner for events that happen in the background
acceptance: packages/ui-web gets a Toast (in /kit): top-right on desktop, above the tab bar on phones; solid surface panel with the float shadow; a polite live region so screen readers announce it; stays 5 s, paused while hovered or focused, closable, keyboard reachable; stacks up to 3; reduced motion removes the movement; no new dependency unless the existing Radix set already has it

apps/web uses it for background events only (form errors stay inline beside their field or form): a payment detected and a payment settled on the active profile while the app is open (from the data the app already polls; never twice for one payment, not for old payments on first load), and billing details saved; unit tests for the which-events-toast logic; Playwright checks a toast appears for a new payment and is announced; axe finds 0 serious or critical violations; DESIGN.md documents when to use a toast
